newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Rebels sign accord ending Central Africa mutiny.
newsitem.headline: Rebels sign accord ending Central Africa mutiny.

text.p: Leaders of an army mutiny in Central African Republic signed an accord on Friday formally ending their three-month uprising, witnesses said.

African mediators who negotiated the deal also signed the document at the residence of the Roman Catholic archbishop of Bangui. The government side had been scheduled to endorse the accord separately at an earlier ceremony.
